parts.text: A student is determining the density of modelling clay. He is using the block shown in Fig. 1.1 and Fig. 1.2. Fig. 1.1 Fig. 1.2 (side view)

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the volume V 1 of the block, using your measurements from (a)(i) and the equation V 1 = l × w × h . V 1 = .................................................. cm 3 [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student suspends the piece of modelling clay from a forcemeter, as shown in Fig. 1.3. Fig. 1.3 Record the weight W of the block of modelling clay shown in Fig. 1.3. W = ..................................................... N [1]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Calculate a value ρ 1 for the density of the modelling clay, using your results from (a)(ii) and (c) and the equation ρ 1 = W × k V 1 , where k = 100 g / N. ρ 1 = ......................................................... [2]

parts.text: (e) The student pours some water into a measuring cylinder, as shown in Fig. 1.4. Fig. 1.4

parts.label: i

parts.label: f

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) • Record the new reading V 3 of the measuring cylinder in Fig. 1.5, with the block of modelling clay in the water.
